# Official public-office fixtures (NRW scope)

Dated read-only qualification (BE-56, 2026-11-07; NRW reduction BE-59,
2026-11-17). Scope JSON manifests identify the exact original gzip payloads,
source URLs, SHA-256 hashes and capture times; decompressing recovers the
original bytes. Only referenced captures are retained. These files support
deterministic offline tests, not a production population claim.

Three scopes remain: `nw` (Landtag NRW, complete), `bt` (Bundestag roster
endpoint captured 2026-11-17 with the official Bundesland facet for
Nordrhein-Westfalen) and `br` (the Bundesrat directory's Nordrhein-Westfalen
Land page and the profiles it links). Captures of the 18 retired scopes were
removed with BE-59 and remain available in Git history.
